why: Image 2 has real depth and night atmosphere: a receding bar with stools, glassware, a beamed ceiling, haze in the pendant light and warm under-counter glow, so it reads like a specific room someone lit and photographed. Image 1 is flat and frontal, its materials look like CG (uniform walnut, a smeared chair back, blank concrete tiles), and the lighting is murky without any motivated source, so it reads as a render; Image 2 has some faults of its own (stool backs that look like slabs, slightly soft and plasticky surfaces) but is still the clearly better picture.
